    function getLocalJson(key) {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
        return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    }

    function setLocalJson(key, value) {
      localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
    }

                  openingBid
                }

                null;

              state.auctionOpeningBid =

              scheduleAuctionReconcile(80);

              );
            }
          }

              || null;

            if (!teamId || !player) {
              return msg('Seleziona squadra e svincolato.', 'warning');

              return msg('La squadra selezionata non ha il turno di chiamata.', 'warning');
            }

            if (!auctionPlayerMatchesCurrentRolePhase(player)) {
              return msg('Il giocatore selezionato non appartiene alla fase ruolo corrente.', 'warning');
            }

            try {
              const openingBid =
                d.settings?.auction_base_mode === 'quotation'
                  ? null
                  : Math.max(1, Number(state.auctionAdminBidAmount || 1));

              await api(
                ENDPOINTS.auction,

                }

              state.auctionAdminPlayerId = null;
              scheduleAuctionReconcile(80);

            } catch (error) {
              msg(error.message, 'error');
            }
          }
        );

    async function toggleImmersion() {
      try {
        if (document.fullscreenElement) {
          await document.exitFullscreen();
        } else {
          await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
        }
      } catch (error) {
        msg('La modalità schermo intero non è disponibile su questo dispositivo.', 'error');
      }
    }


    $('immersion-btn')
      .addEventListener(
        'click',
        toggleImmersion
      );


    document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => {
      const active = Boolean(document.fullscreenElement);
      const title = active
        ? 'Esci dalla vista a schermo intero'
        : 'Vista a schermo intero';

      [
        $('immersion-btn'),
        $('auction-immersion-live')
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .forEach(button => {
          button.textContent = active ? '⤢' : '⛶';
          button.title = title;
          button.setAttribute('aria-label', title);
        });

      if (
        state.view === 'auction'
        && auctionSession()?.status === 'live'
      ) {
        renderAuctionLive();
      }
    });

          clearLocalSession();
          resetAuthenticatedState();
          showLoginGate();

          $('auth-password').value = '';

                sessionToken
              });

    async function loadLeagues() {
      const data = await api(ENDPOINTS.leagues, { action: 'getLeagueHome' }, { league: false });
      if (!data) return;

      renderLeagues(data);
      await loadJoinRequests();
    }

    function renderLeagues(data) {
      const memberships = (data.memberships || []).filter(item =>
        item.league &&
        ['pending', 'active'].includes(item.league.status) &&
        ['pending', 'active'].includes(item.status)
      );

      $('create-league-panel').hidden = !data.permissions?.canCreateLeague;
      $('join-league-panel').hidden = !data.permissions?.canUseAnotherLeague;

      $('my-leagues').innerHTML = memberships.length
        ? memberships.map(item => {
            const league = item.league;
            const active = item.status === 'active' && league.status === 'active';
            return `
              <article class="panel">
                <div class="between">
                  <div>
                    <strong>${esc(league.name)}</strong>

    function attachAuctionRosterQueueToggle() {

    function auctionOptimisticQueueRows(items) {
      const currentRows =
        auctionQueueRows();

      const candidates =
        state.auction?.callCandidates
        || [];

      return items.map((item, index) => {
        const playerId =
          item.playerId;

        const existing =
          currentRows.find(row =>
            row.player_id === playerId
          );

        const player =
          existing?.player
          || candidates.find(candidate =>
            candidate.id === playerId
          )
          || null;

        return {
          ...(existing || {}),
          player_id: playerId,
          player,
          opening_bid: Math.max(1, Number(item.openingBid || 1)),
          position: index + 1
        };
      });
    }

    function bindAuctionRostersAccordion() {
      const strip = $('auction-rosters-toggle-strip');

      if (!strip) {
        return;
      }

      const canView =
        strip.dataset.canViewRosters === 'true';

      const isControlTarget = target =>
        Boolean(
          target?.closest?.(
            'button,input,select,textarea,label,a,[data-no-roster-toggle]'
          )
        );

      const toggle = () => {
        if (!canView) {
          return;
        }

        state.auctionRostersOpen =
          !state.auctionRostersOpen;

        renderAuctionLive();
      };

      strip.addEventListener(
        'click',
        event => {
          if (isControlTarget(event.target)) {
            return;
          }

          toggle();
        }
      );

      strip.addEventListener(
        'keydown',
        event => {
          if (
            isControlTarget(event.target)
            || !['Enter', ' '].includes(event.key)
          ) {
            return;
          }

          event.preventDefault();
          toggle();
        }
      );

      if (!state.auctionRostersOpen) {
        return;
      }

      bindAuctionFreeBidInput(
        'auction-rosters-free-bid',
        'auction-rosters-president-bid',
        'OK · '
      );

      $('auction-rosters-president-bid')
        ?.addEventListener(
          'click',
          event => {
            event.stopPropagation();

            placeBid(
              auctionMyTeamId(),
              Number(
                state.auctionBidSelection
                || auctionBidDefault()
              ),
              'APP'
            );
          }
        );

      $('auction-rosters-leave-player')
        ?.addEventListener(
          'click',
          event => {
            event.stopPropagation();
            leaveCurrentAuctionPlayer();
          }
        );
    }


    function auctionRosterGridLayout(teamCount) {
      const count =
        Math.max(1, Number(teamCount || 0));

      /*
       * V41 · Rose di tutti
       * - fino a 6 squadre: una sola riga, una card per squadra;
       * - oltre 6: il numero minimo possibile di righe, con massimo 6
       *   colonne e card tutte della stessa larghezza.
       *
       * Esempi richiesti:
       *  6 -> 6 x 1
       *  8 -> 4 x 2
       * 10 -> 5 x 2
       * 12 -> 6 x 2
       *
       * Per quantità non divisibili (es. 7, 13) la griglia mantiene la
       * stessa larghezza di card per ogni riga; l'ultima può avere celle
       * non occupate, senza allargare le card residue.
       */
      const rows =
        count <= 6
          ? 1
          : Math.max(2, Math.ceil(count / 6));

      const columns =
        count <= 6
          ? count
          : Math.min(6, Math.ceil(count / rows));

      const

--- MATCH 4 @ 677522 ---
            cards
              || '<div class="my-team-roster-empty">Rose non disponibili.</div>'
            }
          </div>
        </section>
      `;
    }


    function bindAuctionRosterCreditEditors() {
      if (!auctionCanControl()) {
        return;
      }

      document
        .querySelectorAll('[data-edit-roster-credits]')
        .forEach(button => {
          button.addEventListener(
            'click',
            async event => {
              event.preventDefault();
              event.stopPropagation();

              const teamId =
                button.dataset.editRosterCredits;

              if (!teamId) {
                return;
              }

              state.auctionCreditLogTeamId =
                teamId;

              state.auctionCreditLogTeamName =
                button.dataset.teamName
                || 'Squadra';

              state.auctionCreditLogCurrent =
                Number(
                  button.dataset.currentCredits
                  || 0
                );

              state.auctionCreditLogEntries = [];
              state.auctionCreditLogError = '';
              state.auctionCreditLogLoading = true;

              renderAuctionLive();

              try {
                const response = await api(
                  ENDPOINTS.auction,
                  {
                    action: 'getTeamCreditLog',
                    sessionId:
                      auctionSession()?.id,
                    teamId
                  }
                );

                if (
                  state.auctionCreditLogTeamId
                  !== teamId
                ) {
                  return;
                }

                state.auctionCreditLogEntries =
                  response?.entries
                  || [];

                state.auctionCreditLogLoading =
                  false;

                renderAuctionLive();
              } catch (error) {
                if (
                  state.auctionCreditLogTeamId
                  !== teamId
                ) {
                  return;
                }

                state.auctionCreditLogLoading =
                  false;

                state.auctionCreditLogError =
                  error.message
                  || 'Impossibile caricare il log crediti.';

                renderAuctionLive();
              }
            }
          );
        });
    }

    function auctionCreditLogLabel(entry) {

        case 'ROSTER_TEAM_TRANSFERRED':
        case 'ROSTER_PLAYER_TRANSFERRED':
          return `Cambio squadra${entry.player?.name ? ` · ${entry.player.name}` : ''}`;
        case 'OPERATION_UNDONE':
          return `Annullamento · ${payload.undone_event_ty

          return 'Penalità chiamata';
        case 'CREDITS_ADJUSTED':
          return payload.reason
            ? `Rettifica · ${payload.reason}`
            : 'Rettifica crediti';
        case 'ROSTER_PRICE_EDITED':
          return `Modifica prezzo${entry.player?.name ? ` · ${entry.player.name}` : ''}`;
        case 'ROSTER_PLAYER_REMOVED':
          return `Rimozione${entry.player?.name ? ` · ${entry.player.name}` : ''}`;
        case 'ROSTER_TEAM_TRANSFERRED':
        case 'ROSTER_PLAYER_TRANSFERRED':
          return `Cambio squadra${entry.player?.name ? ` · ${entry.player.name}` : ''}`;
        case 'OPERATION_UNDONE':
          return `Annullamento · ${payload.undone_event_type || 'operazione'}`;
        default:
          return entry?.event_type || 'Operazione';
      }
    }

    function auctionCreditLogLabel(entry) {
      const payload = entry?.payload || {};

      switch (entry?.event_type) {
        case 'PLAYER_AWARDED':
        case 'MANUAL_AWARD':
          return `Acquisto${entry.player?.name ? ` · ${entry.player.name}` : ''}`;
        case 'NOMINATION_TIMEOUT':
          return 'Penalità chiamata';
        case 'CREDITS_ADJUSTED':
          return payload.reason
            ? `Rettifica · ${payload.reason}`
            : 'Rettifica crediti';
        case 'ROSTER_PRICE_EDITED':
          return `Modifica prezzo${entry.player?.name ? ` · ${entry.player.name}` : ''}`;
        case 'ROSTER_PLAYER_REMOVED':
          return `Rimozione${entry.player?.name ? ` · ${entry.player.name}` : ''}`;
        case 'ROSTER_TEAM_TRANSFERRED':
        case 'ROSTER_PLAYER_TRANSFERRED':
          return `Cambio squadra${entry.player?.name ? ` · ${entry.player.name}` : ''}`;
        case 'OPERATION_UNDONE':
          return `Annullamento · ${payload.undone_event_type || 'operazione'}`;
        default:
          return entry?.event_type || 'Operazione';
      }
    }

    function bindAuctionCreditLogModal() {
      if (!state.auctionCreditLogTeamId) {
        return;
      }

      const close = () => {
        state.auctionCreditLogTeamId = null;
        state.auctionCreditLogTeamName = '';
        state.auctionCreditLogEntries = [];
        state.auctionCreditLogLoading = false;
        state.auctionCreditLogError = '';
        renderAuctionLive();
      };

      $('auction-credit-log-close')
        ?.addEventListener('click', close);

      document
        .querySelector('.auction-credit-log-modal')
        ?.addEventListener('click', event => {
          if (event.target === event.currentTarget) {
            close();
          }
        });

      $('auction-credit-log-save')
        ?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
          const remaining =
            Number(
              $('auction-credit-log-value')
                ?.value
            );

          const reason =
            String(
              $('auction-credit-log-reason')
                ?.value
              || ''
            ).trim();

          if (
            !Number.isInteger(remaining)
            || remaining < 0
            || remaining > 999999
          ) {
            return msg(
              'Inserisci un valore intero tra 0 e 999999 crediti.',
              'warning'
            );
          }

          if (
            remaining
            === Number(state.auctionCreditLogCurrent || 0)
          ) {
            return msg(
              'Il saldo non è cambiato.',
              'warning'
            );
          }

          if (reason.length < 3) {
            return msg(
              'Inserisci una motivazione di almeno 3 caratteri.',
              'warning'
            );
          }

          const teamId =
            state.auctionCreditLogTeamId;

          try {
            await api(
              ENDPOINTS.auction,
              {
                action: 'setTeamCredits',
                sessionId:
                  auctionSession()?.id,
                teamId,
                remaining,
                reason
              }
            );

            state.auctionCreditLogTeamId = null;
            state.auctionCreditLogEntries = [];
            msg('Crediti aggiornati.', 'success');
            scheduleAuctionReconcile(80);
          } catch (error) {
            msg(error.message, 'error');
          }
        });
    }

    function auctionTeamReference(team, fallback = 'Squadra') {
      const alias =
        String(
          team?.auction_alias
          || team?.auctionAlias
          || ''
        )
          .trim();

      if (alias) {
        return alias
          .toLocaleUpperCase('it-IT')
          .slice(0, 10);
      }

      return String(
        fallback
        || team?.name
        || team?.president?.username
        || team?.presidentUsername
        || 'Squadra'
      );
    }

    function renderAuction() {
      const root = $('auction-root');
      const data = state.auction;
      if (!data) { root.innerHTML='<div class="panel">Caricamento...</div>'; return; }

      const session = data.auctionSession;
      root.className = 'auction-root';
      document.body.classList.toggle('auction-live', session?.status === 'live' && state.view === 'auction');

      if (!session) return renderAuctionLobby();
      if (session.status === 'prepared') return renderAuctionPrepared();
      if (session.status === 'live') return renderAuctionLive();
      if (session.status === 'review') return renderAuctionReview();

      root.innerHTML = `<section class="panel"><strong>Sessione ${esc(session.status)}</strong></section>`;
    }

    function renderAuctionRolePhaseAdminPanel() {
      const phase = state.auction?.rolePhase;
      const session = auctionSession();

      if (
        !phase
        || !session
        || !auctionCallMode()
        || !auctionCanControl()
      ) {
        return '';
      }

      const controllerAction =
        phase.allReady
        && !session.current_player_id
          ? phase.hasNext
            ? `
                <button id="auction-advance-role-phase" class="auction-role-phase-action" type="button">
                  CONFERMA FASE SUCCESSIVA
                </button>
              `
            : '<span class="badge good">ULTIMA FASE COMPLETA · PUOI TERMINARE L’ASTA</span>'
          : '';

      if (!controllerAction) {
        return '';
      }

      return `
        <div class="auction-role-phase-admin-footer">
          ${controllerAction}
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function bindAuctionAwardValidationModal() {
      const session =
        auctionSession();

      if (!session?.id) {
        return;
      }

      $('auction-award-validation-yes')
        ?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
          if (state.auctionAwardValidationBusy) {
            return;
          }

          state.auctionAwardValidationBusy = true;

          try {
            /* Se PAUSA è programmata, awardPlayer la lascia attiva e blocca la chiamata successiva. */
await auctionAction(
              {
                action: 'awardPlayer',
                sessionId: session.id
              },
              'Giocatore aggiudicato.'
            );
          } catch (error) {
            msg(error.message, 'error');
          } finally {
            state.auctionAwardValidationBusy = false;
          }
        });

      $('auction-award-validation-no')
        ?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
          if (state.auctionAwardValidationBusy) {
            return;
          }

          state.auctionAwardValidationBusy = true;

          try {
            /* NO lascia il lotto aperto e congela la ripartenza automatica
               della chiamata successiva dopo l'eventuale aggiudicazione manuale. */
            const response = await api(
              ENDPOINTS.auction,
              {
                action: 'setAuctionPause',
                sessionId: session.id,
                paused: true
              }
            );

            if (response?.state) {
              applyAuctionHotState(response.state, { fromMutation: true });
            }
            scheduleAuctionReconcile(500);
          } catch (error) {
            msg(error.message, 'error');
          } finally {
            state.auctionAwardValidationBusy = false;
          }
        });
    }

    function auctionSettingsRows(settings={}) {
      const roleOrderLabels = {
        free: 'Libero',
        goalkeepers_first: 'Prima portieri',
        pdca: 'PDCA',
        acdp: 'ACDP',
        p_free: 'P-libero'
      };

      const rows = [
        ['Modalità', settings.fantasy_mode],
        ['Crediti', settings.initial_credits],
        ['Chiamata', settings.nomination_mode],
        ['Base', settings.auction_base_mode],
        ['Rilanci', settings.bid_mode],
        ['Timer', settings.timer_mode],
        [
          'Ordine ruoli',
          roleOrderLabels[settings.nomination_role_order || 'free']
        ],
        [
          'Presidenti',
          settings.president_device_mode === 'dual'
            ? 'PC + Smartphone'
            : 'Standard'
        ],
        [
          'Tempo chiamata',
          settings.nomination_timer_enabled !== false
            ? `${settings.nomination_timeout_seconds || 20}s`
            : 'Disattivato'
        ],
        [
          'Penalità',
          settings.nomination_timer_enabled !== false
          && settings.nomination_penalty_enabled !== false
            ? `${settings.nomination_timeout_penalty || 0} crediti`
            : 'Disattivata'
        ]
      ];
      return rows.map(([a,b])=>`<div class="compact-row"><strong>${esc(a)}</strong><span class="badge">${esc(b ?? '—')}</span></div>`).join('');
    }

    async function confirmAuctionRoleReady(teamId, teamName = '') {
      const phase = state.auction?.rolePhase;
      const session = auctionSession();

      if (!phase || !session?.id || !teamId) {
        return;
      }

      const phaseLabel =
        auctionRolePhaseLabel(phase.key);

      const subject =
        teamName
          ? `${teamName} · ${phaseLabel}`
          : phaseLabel;

      if (
        !await appConfirm(
          `Confermi A POSTO per ${subject}? Questa scelta è definitiva e non potrà essere revocata.`
        )
      ) {
        return;
      }

      await auctionAction(
        {
          action: 'confirmRoleReady',
          sessionId: session.id,
          teamId
        },
        `${teamName ? `${teamName}: ` : ''}A POSTO confermato.`
      );
    }


    function auctionControllerTeamMetrics(teamId) {
      const d = state.auction || {};
      const team = (d.teams || []).find(item => item.id === teamId) || null;
      const teamState = (d.teamOrder || []).find(item => item.team_id === teamId) || null;
      const capacity = (d.bidCapacities || []).find(item => item.team_id === teamId) || null;
      const assignments = (state.auctionPersonalRoster?.assignments || [])
        .filter(item => item.team_id === teamId);
      const rosterConfig = parseRosterConfig(d.settings?.roster_config);
      const mode = d.settings?.fantasy_mode || 'classic';

      let rosterMin = 0;
      let rosterMax = 0;

      if (mode === 'classic') {
        const classic = rosterConfig?.classic || {};

        const roleMin = role => {
          const configured = classic?.[role];
          return Number(
            typeof configured === 'object'
              ? configured?.min ?? configured?.max ?? 0
              : configured || 0
          );
        };

        const roleMax = role => {
          const configured = classic?.[role];
          return Number(
            typeof configured === 'object'
              ? configured?.max ?? configured?.min ?? 0
              : configured || 0
          );
        };

        rosterMin = ['P','D','C','A'].reduce(
          (sum, role) => sum + roleMin(role),
          0
        );

        rosterMax = ['P','D','C','A'].reduce(
          (sum, role) => sum + roleMax(role),
          0
        );
      } else {
        const mantra = rosterConfig?.mantra || {};
        rosterMin = Number(mantra?.total?.min ?? capacity?.roster_limit ?? 0);
        rosterMax = Number(mantra?.total?.max ?? capacity?.roster_limit ?? rosterMin);
      }

      const initialCredits = Number(
        d.auctionSession?.setup_snapshot?.initial_credits
        ?? d.settings?.initial_credits
        ?? 0
      );
      const debits = Number(teamState?.credits_spent || 0);
      const creditAdjustment = Number(teamState?.credi
